attrs.description: Reproduces a reported failure inside the lane, localizes its cause (bisecting when a known-good commit exists), proposes the failing test that will pin it, and names the kind of work the evidence shows. Writes only the lane's progress file; the planner writes the spec, the tester the test, the implementer the fix. First agent of the fix and incident profiles.

nodes.label: debugger
nodes.purpose: Reproduces a failure, localizes it, writes the failing test, and names the kind of work the evidence shows; never fixes.
nodes.writes: test files and the lane progress file only

attrs.description: Builds exactly what an approved spec says, in its own worktree, tests first, under hooks that block unread or out-of-spec edits. Use for /zi-implement.

nodes.label: implementer
nodes.purpose: Builds exactly what the approved spec says, in its own worktree, and nothing more.
nodes.writes: the spec's file list only

attrs.description: Turns research into an implementable spec with a file allow-list, impact analysis, tests per done-criterion, and no open questions. Use for /zi-plan. Never edits source.

nodes.label: planner
nodes.purpose: Turns research into an implementable spec with a file allow-list and a test for each done-criterion.
nodes.writes: the spec only

attrs.description: Answers exactly one research question about the codebase, a library, or an external system, and writes a tagged research file. Use for /zi-research. Never edits source.

nodes.label: researcher
nodes.purpose: Answers one research question and writes one tagged research file.
nodes.writes: docs/research/<slug>.md and its index row

attrs.description: After a merge, finds what went wrong in a lane, states the rule that would have prevented it, and proposes the hook, lint, or test that enforces it. Use for /zi-retro. Writes a lesson entry only after human approval.

nodes.label: retro
nodes.purpose: Finds what went wrong in a merged lane and proposes the rule and the check that would have caught it.
nodes.writes: nothing; proposes lessons for human approval

attrs.description: Reviews a lane's diff against its spec with fresh context, re-runs the tests, writes an adversarial test, and produces a PASS/FAIL checklist with evidence. Never sees the builder's conversation. Use for /zi-review.

nodes.label: reviewer
nodes.purpose: Reviews the diff against the spec with fresh context and returns PASS or FAIL with evidence.
nodes.writes: the review file and one adversarial test

attrs.description: Reads a spec and its research with fresh eyes and lists gaps, contradictions, missing callers, untested criteria, and understated risks. Appends a Critique section. Never approves, never rewrites.

nodes.label: spec-critic
nodes.purpose: Reads a spec with fresh eyes and lists gaps and understated risks; never approves or rewrites.
nodes.writes: a Critique section in the spec

attrs.description: Writes the tests for every done-criterion in an approved spec, plus edge and negative cases, and runs them red before any implementation exists. Never writes application code. Runs in the lane before the implementer.

nodes.label: tester
nodes.purpose: Writes failing tests for every done-criterion before any implementation exists.
nodes.writes: test files only

nodes.label: docs
nodes.purpose: Checks that the kit's own research document passes its own validator.

attrs.display_name: eval smoke set (agents, skills, templates, workflows, eval)

nodes.label: eval-smoke
nodes.purpose: On kit PRs: proves the eval gate with recorded fixtures and names the gated paths the PR touches; no credential reaches a pull request (0016 E.11).

attrs.display_name: eval smoke set against the real agents (main)

nodes.label: eval-smoke-main
nodes.purpose: On pushes to main: runs the smoke set against the real agents over the gated paths the push touched, with the credential from the main environment; fails loudly when none arrives.

nodes.label: scripts
nodes.purpose: Runs the kit's own unit tests on Node 20 and 22, the planted-fault suite, the hook settings check and the install check.

nodes.label: audit
nodes.purpose: Audits dependencies for known vulnerabilities; for npm, a ratchet where only advisories a named human accepted with an expiry may stay.

nodes.label: boundaries
nodes.purpose: Checks that layers import only what the architecture allows.

attrs.display_name: dashboard (GitHub Pages, opt-in via repository variable KIT_DASHBOARD_PAGES=true)

nodes.label: dashboard
nodes.purpose: Publishes a static dashboard to GitHub Pages when the project opts in.

nodes.label: format
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's formatter in check mode.

nodes.label: integration
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's integration command against the lane database adapter.

nodes.label: kit-checks
nodes.purpose: Runs the kit's CI checks: scope, test count, dependencies, CLAUDE.md size, guards, docs, review report and PR size.

nodes.label: lint
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's linter.

nodes.label: mutation
nodes.purpose: Measures how well the tests catch changes to the code; warning-only until the gate says otherwise.

nodes.label: mutation-gate
nodes.purpose: Decides whether the mutation job is allowed to block.

nodes.label: secrets
nodes.purpose: Scans the commits in each change for secrets with the gitleaks binary, pinned by version and checksum, using a read-only token.

nodes.label: tests
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's test command, then the coverage command and the coverage floor check (the floor only rises).

nodes.label: typecheck
nodes.purpose: Runs the project's type checker.

nodes.label: audit
nodes.purpose: Fails on a dependency advisory at or above the level that is neither fixed nor accepted, with reason and expiry, by a named human in .claude/audit-baseline.json.

nodes.label: boundaries-simple
nodes.purpose: Checks import boundaries from the architecture layers table when no dedicated tool is installed.

nodes.label: changed-docs
nodes.purpose: Validates every document changed against the base branch.

nodes.label: claude-md-cap
nodes.purpose: Fails when CLAUDE.md grows past its size cap.

nodes.label: coverage-floor
nodes.purpose: Fails when line coverage drops below kit.json coverage_floor or the floor itself was lowered; with --ratchet raises the floor to the measured value.

nodes.label: dep-diff
nodes.purpose: Fails when a dependency is added that the spec does not declare.

nodes.label: guards-present
nodes.purpose: Fails when a kit hook is missing or changed, hooks are disabled, or hooks point at scripts that no longer exist; the project's own hooks may sit next to the kit's.

nodes.label: lane-artifacts
nodes.purpose: Fails when a lane artifact sits outside the project's one artifact tree (kit.json paths.work) or a source file sits inside it.

nodes.label: mutation-gate
nodes.purpose: Decides whether the mutation-score job blocks, once enough features have merged.

nodes.label: pr-size
nodes.purpose: Warns when a PR is large enough that its spec should have been split.

nodes.label: review-report
nodes.purpose: Fails a lane branch without a valid PASS review that names the current head commit.

nodes.label: scope-diff
nodes.purpose: Fails a lane branch that changes files outside its spec.

nodes.label: security-floor
nodes.purpose: Fails when any settings scope loosens the kit's security floor: a floor deny entry missing, an allow that grants what the floor denies, or hooks disabled.

nodes.label: test-count
nodes.purpose: Fails when the number of test cases drops without the spec saying why.

nodes.label: budget-check
nodes.purpose: Stops a lane that exceeds its time or tool-call budget by writing an escalation.

nodes.label: config-guard
nodes.purpose: Blocks changes to project settings while a lane is active.

nodes.label: done-check
nodes.purpose: Refuses to let the implementer stop while a done-criterion lacks a green run.

nodes.label: event-log
nodes.purpose: Appends one event line per tool call, which the dashboard reads.

nodes.label: guard-bash
nodes.purpose: Blocks destructive git and shell commands and pushes to the default branch.

nodes.label: guard-edit
nodes.purpose: Blocks edits to files the session has not read, files outside the spec, and protected paths.

nodes.label: guard-read
nodes.purpose: Blocks reads of secrets and credential files.

nodes.label: guard-tests-only
nodes.purpose: Limits the tester to test files and lane-owned docs.

nodes.label: notify
nodes.purpose: Tells the human when something needs them, by desktop notification or webhook.

nodes.label: post-edit-check
nodes.purpose: After each edit runs typecheck, lint and tests, logs the result and feeds failures back to the agent.

nodes.label: read-log
nodes.purpose: Records which files the session has read, for the edit guard to consult.

nodes.label: session-context
nodes.purpose: Re-injects the lane's spec, progress and lessons when a session is compacted or resumed.

nodes.label: app_token.js
nodes.purpose: The agents' GitHub identity: signs the kit App's JWT and mints a short-lived installation token limited to one repository, for lane.js publish alone; the key stays outside every repository and the token is never printed.

nodes.label: arch_live.js
nodes.purpose: Reads the facts that depend on the machine: git state, one component's history, and how a project's hooks compare with the kit's.

nodes.label: arch_manifest.js
nodes.purpose: Builds this map from the repository and fails CI when the map and the code disagree.

nodes.label: args.js
nodes.purpose: Command-line argument parser shared by the scripts.

nodes.label: bootstrap.js
nodes.purpose: Detects the stack and generates or upgrades a project's kit layer.

nodes.label: check_projects.js
nodes.purpose: Warns about registered projects whose hooks point at scripts the kit no longer has.

nodes.label: ci_common.js
nodes.purpose: Helpers shared by the CI check scripts.

nodes.label: dashboard/server.js
nodes.purpose: Serves the dashboard and its read-only APIs on localhost; nothing it shows comes from an agent.

nodes.label: eval/harness.js
nodes.purpose: Runs the benchmark tasks through a runner, scores them, compares with the committed baseline, and fails on a hard-metric violation or a regression.

nodes.label: eval/runners/claude.js
nodes.purpose: Runs a task as a sandboxed headless Claude Code session on a fixture repo and grades the end state with a separate judge session.

nodes.label: eval/runners/fixture.js
nodes.purpose: Replays recorded outcomes for the kit's own tests and keyless machines; never a baseline source.

nodes.label: eval/score.js
nodes.purpose: Scores one task outcome: mechanical hard checks first, then the rubric share; a hard violation zeroes the score.

nodes.label: kit_status.js
nodes.purpose: Derives each feature's position and the project's health from files and git.

nodes.label: kitlib.js
nodes.purpose: Shared foundation: git, JSON, paths, lane files and the block/feedback conventions every hook and script uses.

nodes.label: lane.js
nodes.purpose: Mechanical half of the pipeline: worktrees, preconditions, roadmap status, and the next-step state machine.

nodes.label: metrics.js
nodes.purpose: Reports cost, tokens, API and tool activity per lane and project from the telemetry store alone; null and flagged when the store has nothing, never estimated.

nodes.label: permission_probe.js
nodes.purpose: Proves with Claude Code itself that every allow rule the kit ships approves its command and that the controls stay refused (#63); run by hand with a credential, never in CI.

nodes.label: pr_gate.js
nodes.purpose: The merge gate: waits for every required job of the project workflow on a PR head and merges only when all passed; the same job list feeds branch protection.

nodes.label: sandbox.js
nodes.purpose: Detects the lane sandbox runtime (srt, container, or none), builds a lane's sandbox configuration from the floor and its spec, scans the worktree for credential-looking content, and forms the host-side launch command.

nodes.label: shell_changes.js
nodes.purpose: Works out which files a Bash call changed in a lane's worktree: a snapshot before the call (guard-bash) against one after (post-edit-check), regular files and symlinks only, so sandbox masks and files that were already there are never blamed on it; keeps the out-of-scope paths flagged until undone (post-edit-check, done-check).

nodes.label: telemetry/collector.js
nodes.purpose: Receives Claude Code's OpenTelemetry export (OTLP/HTTP JSON) and appends every record, tagged with its lane, to the kit telemetry store; stores, never interprets.

nodes.label: validate_docs.js
nodes.purpose: Rejects research, specs, reviews and lessons that make untagged or unresolvable claims.

attrs.description: Starts a change to the declared architecture or design model as work type architecture: research, plan, approval, build, review, merge. Use when the structure of the system should change.

nodes.label: zi-architecture
nodes.purpose: Starts a change to the declared architecture or design model: research, propose, critique, approval, then lanes.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Sets up the kit in a repository: detects the stack, asks what it must not guess, and writes CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN.md, LESSONS.md, docs/, hooks, CI and the sync script. Use once per repository, and with --upgrade after updating the kit.

nodes.label: zi-bootstrap
nodes.purpose: Detects a repository's stack and installs the kit's project layer, hooks and CI.

attrs.description: Starts the live dashboard for this project (or every project with --all): where each feature is, lane details, and hook events as they happen. Use to watch the kit work.

nodes.label: zi-dashboard
nodes.purpose: Starts the live dashboard for this project or all registered projects.

attrs.description: Starts a documentation-only change as work type docs. Use when only documentation changes.

nodes.label: zi-docs
nodes.purpose: Starts a documentation change: inspect, edit, validate, review, merge.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Starts a fix for a described bug as work type fix: reproduce, spec, approval, tests, build, review, merge, retro. Use when something is broken and the symptom can be described.

nodes.label: zi-fix
nodes.purpose: Starts a fix under the fix profile: debugger reproduces and pins, implementer fixes, review, merge.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Builds an approved spec in its own worktree: the tester writes failing tests, then the implementer makes them pass under the lane hooks. Refuses without an approval line, with open questions, past the WIP limit, or on file overlap. Use when a spec is approved, or to continue a lane.

nodes.label: zi-implement
nodes.purpose: Builds an approved spec in its own worktree with the tester and implementer under lane hooks.

attrs.description: Starts the handling of a production incident as work type incident: reproduce, spec, approval, tests, build, review, merge, retro. Use when production is broken.

nodes.label: zi-incident
nodes.purpose: Starts incident response: triage, contain, diagnose, recover, verify, retrospective.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Starts an investigation as work type investigation: research ending in a report, with no code change. Use when the user wants an answer about the code or a system, not a change.

nodes.label: zi-investigate
nodes.purpose: Answers a question about the codebase: inspect, research, report; no code changes.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Starts a data or schema migration as work type migration, always at high risk. Use when data or a schema must be migrated.

nodes.label: zi-migrate
nodes.purpose: Starts a data or schema migration: always high risk, with backup and restore validation.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Starts a new capability as work type feature: research, plan, approval, tests, build, review, merge, retro. Use when the user wants something the product does not do yet.

nodes.label: zi-new-feature
nodes.purpose: Starts a feature under the feature profile: research, plan, critique, approval, tests, build, review, merge, retro.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Starts adding or changing a kit skill as work type skill-development. Its plan and build stages need the skill-smith agent, which does not exist yet (#59). Use when a kit skill should be added or changed.

nodes.label: zi-new-skill
nodes.purpose: Starts kit-level skill development: gap, research, skill-smith draft, review, eval, approval, release.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Writes the spec for a feature: the planner drafts it, open unknowns are researched, the spec critic reviews it, and it is validated. Refuses at the WIP limit, on file overlap, or with too little research. Use when the research for a feature is done; the human approves the spec afterwards.

nodes.label: zi-plan
nodes.purpose: Turns research into a validated spec through planner, spec-critic and the unknown-question budget.

attrs.description: Starts a restructuring of code that keeps its behaviour, as work type refactor: research, plan, approval, tests, build, review, merge. Use when code should change shape but not behaviour.

nodes.label: zi-refactor
nodes.purpose: Starts a behaviour-preserving refactor: analysis, plan with one caller per criterion, pinning tests, incremental build, verify.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Answers the questions a feature or topic needs before planning, one researcher per question, reusing or re-checking research that already exists. Writes only research files. Use before /zi-plan, or on a topic of its own.

nodes.label: zi-research
nodes.purpose: Runs one researcher per question, reusing indexed research when it is still current.

attrs.description: Turns a merged lane, or with --incident a production incident, into lessons: the retro agent proposes each lesson and the check that would have caught it, the human accepts, edits or drops each, and the worktree is cleaned up. Use after a merge or an incident.

nodes.label: zi-retro
nodes.purpose: After a merge, proposes lessons and enforcement changes and writes them only on human approval.

attrs.description: Reviews a lane's pull request with a fresh reviewer that never saw the builder's conversation (a second one on high-risk specs), writes the review report and posts any fail list to the PR. Never merges. Use when a lane's PR is ready for review.

nodes.label: zi-review
nodes.purpose: Runs the fresh-context reviewer (and a second one on high-risk specs) and posts the fail list.

attrs.description: Carries a feature through every stage (research, spec, approval, tests, build, review, merge, retro), asking kit lane next-step what comes next each time and stopping only where a human must act. Use to start or resume work on a feature that has an agreed goal, or with --queue to work through the roadmap.

nodes.label: zi-run
nodes.purpose: Carries one feature from agreed goal to merged PR, asking the next-step script what comes next and stopping only for a human.
nodes.writes: nothing itself; every stage is an agent or a script

attrs.description: Starts work on a security finding or review as work type security, always at high risk. Use when there is a security finding or a security review to do.

nodes.label: zi-security
nodes.purpose: Starts security work: always high risk, threat model, second reviewer, human security sign-off.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.description: Agrees the end goal of a piece of work with the human in a short discussion, then writes the goal file and the roadmap row and offers to hand off to /zi-run. Use when there is something to build and no agreed goal yet.

nodes.label: zi-start
nodes.purpose: Agrees the end goal with the human, then writes the goal file and roadmap row and hands off to /zi-run.

attrs.description: Shows where every feature stands and what is waiting for the human: positions, lane drift, debt and stale research, all read from files and git. Use to see the state of the work.

nodes.label: zi-status
nodes.purpose: Prints where every feature is and what needs the human, derived from files and git.

attrs.description: Merges the default branch into a lane's worktree and runs the tests; a conflict is reported, with one attempt to resolve it. Use when a lane has fallen behind the default branch.

nodes.label: zi-sync
nodes.purpose: Brings a worktree up to date with the default branch and runs the tests.

attrs.description: Starts a change to a screen or its style as work type ui, checked against the design model; at size L it runs as a feature. Use when the change is to what the user sees.

nodes.label: zi-ui
nodes.purpose: Starts a UI change under the ui profile: inspect, build, visual and accessibility verification, review; feature shape at size L.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

attrs.argument_hint: <the symptom or wish, in your own words>
attrs.description: Starts work whose kind is unknown as a provisional fix; the debugger's evidence then settles whether it is a fix, an incident or a refactor. Use when something is wrong and the kind of work is not clear.

nodes.label: zi-work
nodes.purpose: Routes work whose kind is unknown: provisionally fix, then the debugger's evidence settles fix, incident or refactor.
nodes.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run
